description: Computes eight logic functions over as many as 16 inputs, counting only the inputs that are patched

params.text: Inverts that input before the logic functions are computed

inputs.text: One of the logic inputs; only patched inputs are counted, and a voltage above 1V counts as true, despite the manual giving the threshold as 0.5V

outputs.text: Carries 10V while every patched input is true, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while at least one patched input is false, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while at least one patched input is true, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while every patched input is false, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the number of true inputs is even, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the number of true inputs is odd, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while exactly one input is true, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the number of true inputs is anything other than one, and 0V otherwise

notes: only patched inputs are counted; with none patched at all every output carries 0V, the negated outputs included
the module is mono: it reads the first channel of a polyphonic cable and ignores the rest, and every output carries a single channel
